english.title: Exporter of dutiable goods where entry cancelled fail to ensure sum not paid / repay sum
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an exporter where an entry in respect of

(A)_[dutiable]_
(B)_[restricted]_

goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), was treated as cancelled by virtue of section 56 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979, and having been entitled to the payment of a sum

(C)_[from the Commissioners]_
(D)_[under an EU instrument]_

(E)_[failed to take such steps as directed by the Commissioners to ensure that the sum was not paid to you]_
(F)_[and that sum having been paid, failed to repay it within seven days or longer period allowed by the Commissioners]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 56(3)(a) and (5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
